name: Tempered Steel
body:
Tempered Steel (Su) [Torag]
Source Mythic Origins pg. 7
As a swift action while wearing armor, you can expend one use of mythic power to gain DR 5/adamantine. Once this effect has prevented a total of 20 points of damage per tier you possess, the protection ends. For example, a mythic character with 3 mythic tiers could prevent a total of 60 points of non-adamantine damage with this effect.
